title: Un-export coerceLegacyPhase so the state export census stops drifting
regen_obligation_ack: cell runs the full regen chain in its action and pins it with release_manifest.mjs --check plus test_impact_registry.mjs in verify
action: vd-2 introduced coerceLegacyPhase as an EXPORTED binding at packages/bee/lib/state.mjs:76, but packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs:1150-1156 asserts exact-set equality between lib/state.mjs's export surface and EXPECTED_STATE_EXPORTS, so any extra export is red. The red is real and reproduces now: node packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs reports FAIL 'readConfig strips a stale advisor key and never throws; advisor exports are gone'. Baseline commit 33d58a7e does not have it, so slice 1 introduced it. FIX: drop the 'export' keyword from state.mjs:76 -- all three call sites (:1115, :1169, :1727) are inside state.mjs itself, so nothing outside the module needs the binding. Do NOT add the name to EXPECTED_STATE_EXPORTS: that allowlist is a deliberate exact-set fence and widening it to admit an unnecessary export defeats it. Mirror into .bee/bin/lib/state.mjs in the same commit. Run the regen chain inside this cell in this order: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs, then node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, then node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write, then node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write.

truths: coerceLegacyPhase is still applied at all three call sites and legacy coercion behavior is unchanged

artifacts.substantive: coerceLegacyPhase declared without the export keyword

key_links: the .bee/bin twin changes in the same commit
prohibitions: No new name added to EXPECTED_STATE_EXPORTS
No change to the coercion logic or its call sites
No weakening of the exact-set export assertion

verify: node packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs && node packages/bee/tests/test_guards.mjs && node scripts/tests/test_impact_registry.mjs && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check

trace.outcome: Dropped export keyword from coerceLegacyPhase (packages/bee/lib/state.mjs:76, mirrored .bee/bin/lib/state.mjs); ran full regen chain; test_misc.mjs 118/0, test_guards.mjs 62/0, test_impact_registry.mjs 21/0, release_manifest --check all green
